Container.Name: lidarr-deemix
Container.Overview: Enriches Lidarr with Deezer metadata. Configure Lidarr to use this container as HTTP(S) proxy (Settings - General). WARNING: the proxy port is an anonymous forward proxy - do not expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: DEEMIX_ARL
Config.Description: Your Deezer ARL token to fetch artists/albums from Deezer. Without it, the container works as a plain MusicBrainz proxy.

Config.Name: OVERRIDE_MB
Config.Description: Only use Deezer artists/albums instead of MusicBrainz (WARNING: removes MB-imported artists)

Config.Name: PRIO_DEEMIX
Config.Description: Prefer Deezer albums over MusicBrainz albums when both exist

Config.Name: PREFER_SPECIAL_EDITIONS
Config.Description: Prefer Deluxe/Extended editions over standard albums during deduplication

Config.Name: LIDARR_URL
Config.Description: Your Lidarr instance URL (optional, improves artist matching for Deezer albums)

Config.Name: LIDARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your Lidarr instance API key (optional, used together with LIDARR_URL)

Config.Name: DEEMIX_MAX_ALBUMS
Config.Description: Maximum Deezer album search results fetched per artist refresh

Config.Name: MITM_EXTRA_ARGS
Config.Description: Extra mitmdump arguments, e.g. --proxyauth user:pass to lock down the proxy port
